'''Tomasz Ganicz''', [[Pseudonym|ps.]] ''Polimerek'' (born 27 August 1966 in [[Łódź]]<ref>{{Cite web|title=Ganicz Tomasz|url=https://obywatelemajaglos.pl/encyclopedia/ganicz-tomasz/|last=|first=|date=2019-05-23|website=Obywatele mają głos|language=pl-PL|access-date=2020-05-24}}</ref>), is a Polish chemist, [[Habilitation|doctor habilitas]] of chemical sciences and [[professor extraordinarius]] at the [[Military University of Technology in Warsaw]].<ref name="naukapolska">{{cite web|title=dr hab. Tomasz Ganicz|url=http://nauka-polska.pl/dhtml/raporty/ludzieNauki?rtype=opis&objectId=25947&lang=pl|archive-url=https://archive.today/20130824201559/http://nauka-polska.pl/dhtml/raporty/ludzieNauki?rtype=opis&objectId=25947&lang=pl|url-status=dead|archive-date=24 August 2013|website=nauka-polska.pl|publisher=Ośrodek Przetwarzania Informacji – Państwowy Instytut Badawczy|accessdate=4 May 2017}}</ref> He was the president of [[Wikimedia Polska]] (2007–2018).<ref name="Polimerek2015">{{cite web|author1=YOONA HA|author2=VICTOR GRIGAS|title=Tomasz Ganicz recalls the early days of the Polish Wikipedia|url=http://blog.wikimedia.org/2015/06/08/tomasz-ganicz-polish-wikipedia/|website=blog.wikimedia.org|accessdate=4 May 2017|language=en|date=8 June 2015|archive-date=19 June 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150619015741/http://blog.wikimedia.org/2015/06/08/tomasz-ganicz-polish-wikipedia/|url-status=dead}}</ref>

== Life ==
He graduated from chemistry at the [[Technical University of Lodz]] (1991).<ref name="naukapolska"/>
